title: Student V0.1 V5 runtime and Atlas projection R1
purpose: Implement and qualify only R2 Handoff 3: explicit learnit.kit.v5 runtime admission, learner-safe V5 projection, embedded asset preservation, offline learner references, post-transition feedback-media projection, and durable Atlas hint reveal using the existing assistance journal.
invariants: V5 is admitted explicitly and is never converted to or from V4.
V2/V3/V4 runtime behavior and V4 bytes remain unchanged.
V5 initial learner projection contains no hints key and no unrevealed hint text.
Feedback-placement media is absent from initial V5 projection and available only through an explicit post-transition seam.
Learner references are projected only as {url,label,hook} and require no runtime network fetch.
Atlas hint rank is reconstructed only from durable hint AssistanceUseRecords cross-checked with the ResumeState assistanceUseIds for the exact session/item and pinned content revision.
No new Atlas persistence counter, store, table, schema version, sidecar, or content-revision fallback exists.
ActivityResponse, authored answers, scoring rules and evaluation semantics remain unchanged.
nonGoals: Final Pour aller plus loin UI.
Merge, cherry-pick, promotion or student session.
rollback: Close the unmerged draft PR and delete the Handoff-3 branch; Handoff 2 remains the unchanged qualified parent.
